description: The estimated volume of blood lost by the patient during the surgical procedure, expressed in milliliters.
examples: Estimated blood loss is 120 milliliters.
The patient lost approximately 120 ml of blood.
Blood loss during the procedure was around 120 cc.

description: The patient's body temperature measured during the surgical procedure, expressed in degrees Celsius.
examples: The patient's temperature is 37 degrees Celsius.
Body temperature was measured at 36.8 degrees.
The current temperature is 37.2 Celsius.

description: Indicates whether the patient's allergy status was explicitly checked and confirmed before or during the surgical procedure.
examples: The patient's allergy status has been confirmed.
Allergies were checked and confirmed.
Allergy verification is complete.

description: The substances, medications, foods, or materials to which the patient has a known allergy.
examples: The patient is allergic to penicillin.
Known allergy is latex.
The patient has no known allergies.

description: The recorded time at which the first surgical incision was made.
examples: The incision was made at 9:15 AM.
Surgery incision began at fourteen twenty.
The first cut was performed at 10:30.

description: The primary surgeon responsible for performing the procedure.
examples: The primary surgeon is Dr. Rami Khalil.
Dr. Nour Haddad is performing the operation.
The procedure will be led by surgeon Dr. Samir Ali.

description: The name of the anesthesiologist responsible for administering and monitoring anesthesia during the surgical procedure.
examples: The anesthesiologist is Dr. Karim Haddad.
Dr. Haddad is managing the patient's anesthesia.
Anesthesia will be administered by Dr. Karim Haddad.

description: The type or technique of anesthesia administered to the patient for the surgical procedure.
examples: The patient will receive general anesthesia.
Spinal anesthesia was administered.
The procedure is being performed under local anesthesia.

description: The full name of the patient undergoing the procedure.
examples: The patient's name is Sarah Khalil.
The patient is named John Smith.
Patient identity was confirmed as Maya Haddad.

description: The identifier or number of the operating room where the surgical procedure takes place.
examples: The operation is taking place in operating room three.
The assigned OR room is number seven.
The patient is in OR twelve.

description: The unique identifier assigned to a surgical case for documentation and tracking.
examples: The case ID is OR-2026-015.
Record this procedure under case number 4521.
The surgical case identifier is C-108.

description: An unplanned or unusual clinical event that occurs during the surgical procedure and does not correspond to another configured field.
examples: The patient developed an unexpected skin reaction.
There was a sudden equipment malfunction during the procedure.
An unplanned delay occurred because additional imaging was required.
The patient experienced an unexpected physiological complication during surgery, including a sudden decrease in oxygen saturation.
The procedure was completed without any unplanned complications or unusual events.
No intraoperative complications or unforeseen events were reported.
